four_fields.mechanism: For binary fixed-C ranking, fullY IDCG multiplies candidate-normalized NDCG and linear lambda/Hessian coefficients by I(c)/I(m).
four_fields.prediction: Unequal covered/full positive counts change relative query coefficients; full coverage or bothcounts>=K gives no correction.
four_fields.nearest_experiment: UNRUN six invented queries,<=32Crows,<=48fulltargetpairs,3scorevectors,<=6000 paircoefficient checks, plus nonlinear-normalization/cutoff counterexamples.
four_fields.task1_benefit: A controlled future interpretation of surrogate query weighting, not new predictive information or guaranteed gain.

math_contract.lambda_identity: Same pair numerator and linear normalization: lambda_full=ratio*lambda_C; Hessian coefficient scales too.
math_contract.zero_support: No candidatepositive implies equal labels and no pair gradient; emptyC/zeroY/allpositive/singletons retain manifest/evaluation identity.

normalization_counterexample.relation: generally unequal for w!=1; score-distance adjustment does not fix this
normalization_counterexample.controlled_setting: norm=false in both conceptual arms; otherwise specify and test the transformed objective

cutoff_caveat: Pinned LightGBM pair loop takes i<truncation and j beyond it, using both native position discounts. This must not be asserted identical to zero-discount beyondK of exact fullY NDCG20; correction addresses denominator only.
strong_control: Uniform coefficient matched to total informative-query weight; same learner/Q/C/featurematrix/pairs/capacity/seed/iterations/init/norm. No standalone newlearner-vsCatBoost inference.
train_availability: Only full mature train labels known before fit form weights; no labels as features, query choice, sampler/adaptive earlystop or metadata; no current B/W modification.
counterhypothesis: Finite model sharing/variance/regularization can make fullY reweighting worse despite coefficient alignment. Primary coverage ceiling remains unreachable.

primary_sources.scope: Metric-weighted pair logistic surrogate and cutoff adaptation; benchmark does not study REES46 missing-from-C purchases.
